exposure: delivery in hospitals located in Miami-Dade County
cohort: 412,192 nulliparous women in Florida giving birth to singleton, vertex, live births at 37-40 weeks gestation between 2004 and 2011
finding: Hospital geographic location and individual-level risk factors, including maternal ethnicity, contribute to variations in primary cesarean delivery rates among low-risk women in Florida, highlighting the need for targeted quality improvement efforts.
